blocks.text: Muscle (patha) woh tissue hai jo ek tarteeb aur hum-aahangi se sukar (contract ho) kar jism ke hisson ya poore jism ko harkat deta hai. Muscle ke alag alag cells ko muscle fibres ya myofibres kehte hain.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Muscles ka sukarna aur dheela hona sirf jism ko harkat hi nahin deta, balke woh zor bhi deta hai jo khoon aur khaane jaisi cheezon ko jism ke andar aage dhakelta hai.
Muscles ki qismein (Types of Muscles)
Insani jism mein teen qism ke muscle tissues hain: skeletal, smooth aur cardiac (Fig. 12.19).

blocks.title: Doosre janwaron mein muscles
blocks.text: Is chapter mein hum insan ki baat kar rahe hain, lekin taqreeban tamam janwar muscles istemal karte hain. Maslan machhar jab urta hai to us ke par urne wale muscles ke tezi se sukarne se hawa mein tez tez hilte hain. Kenchua (earthworm) jab mitti mein surakh banata hai to us ke taqatwar muscles us ke jism ko aas paas ki mitti mein aage dhakelte hain.
1- Skeletal muscles

Skeletal muscles jism ke hisson, maslan bazu taangon, dhar (trunk) aur chehre ko hilate hain. Skeletal muscle ke fibres lambe cells hain jin par dhaariyan (striations) hoti hain. In ka sukarna aam taur par hamari marzi (conscious control) se hota hai, is liye inhen voluntary (ikhtiyari) muscles kehte hain.
2- Smooth muscles

Smooth muscles maide (stomach), aanton, khoon ki naliyon aur doosre andar ke aza ki deewaron mein hote hain. Smooth muscle fibres takle (spindle) jaise hote hain, in mein ek nucleus hota hai aur dhaariyan nahin hotin. Smooth muscle fibres ke gird connective tissue hota hai. In ki zyada tar harkat hamari marzi se nahin hoti, is liye smooth muscle ko involuntary (ghair-ikhtiyari) muscle kehte hain.
3- Cardiac muscles

Yeh sirf dil ki deewaron mein hote hain. In ke fibres mein bohat shakhen (branches) hoti hain. Cardiac muscle fibres par skeletal muscle ki tarah dhaariyan hoti hain, lekin har cell mein aam taur par ek nucleus hota hai jo beech ke qareeb hota hai.

blocks.caption: Teen qism ke muscle tissues ka muqabla (Comparison of three types of muscle tissues)
rows: Aam taur par ikhtiyari qaboo nahin

blocks.alt: Teen panels. Skeletal muscle: lambe mutawazi dhaaridar (striated) reshe jin ke kinaron ke paas bohat se nuclei hain. Smooth muscle: takle (spindle) jaise cells, dhaariyon ke baghair, har ek mein beech mein ek nucleus. Cardiac muscle: shakhon wale dhaaridar reshe jo intercalated disks se sire se sira jure hain, beech mein nuclei. Labels: Striations, Nucleus, Plasma membrane, Intercalated disk.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.19: Pathon ki qismein (kitab ki Figure 12.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teenon ko teen nishanion se pehchanein: dhaariyan (skeletal aur cardiac mein, smooth mein nahin), nuclei ki tadaad aur jagah (skeletal mein bohat aur kinare par, baqi mein ek aur beech mein), aur intercalated disks (sirf cardiac mein), jo dil ke cells ko ek saath sukarne dete hain. Kitab saath khurdbeen ki tasveerein bhi chhapti hai; woh yahan nahin bani.
Skeletal muscles ki banawat (Structure)

Skeletal muscle ke cells, yani muscle fibres (myofibres), guchhon (bundles) ki shakal mein hote hain jo collagen fibres aur connective tissue mein lipte hote hain. Skeletal muscle ke siron par yahi collagen aur connective tissue tendons banate hain, jo muscle ko haddiyon se jorte hain.
Skeletal muscles ki ultrastructure (bareek banawat)

Har skeletal muscle cell, yani muscle fibre, ek lamba (cylindrical) cell hai jis mein bohat se nuclei hote hain. Is ke gird plasma membrane hoti hai jise sarcolemma kehte hain (Fig. 12.20). Is ke cytoplasm ko sarcoplasm kehte hain, aur is mein sarcoplasmic reticulum (SR) hota hai. Sarcolemma cell ke andar gehrai tak ja kar khokhli lambi naliyan banati hai jinhen transverse tubules (T-tubules) kehte hain. T-tubules SR ke siron tak pohanchti hain.

Har muscle fibre mein 4 se 20 lambe dhaage jaise hisson ka guchha hota hai jinhen myofibrils kehte hain. Myofibrils do qism ke filaments se bani hain: mote (thick) filaments jo myosin protein ke bane hain, aur patle (thin) filaments jo actin protein ke bane hain. Mote filaments gehri pattiyan (dark bands) banate hain jinhen A-bands kehte hain, aur patle filaments halki pattiyan (light bands) banate hain jinhen I-bands kehte hain. Yahi baari baari gehri aur halki pattiyan skeletal muscle ko dhaari dar (striated) banati hain.

Patle actin filaments protein ki discs se jure hote hain jinhen Z-lines kehte hain. Do Z-lines ke beech ka hissa sarcomere kehlata hai; yeh muscle ke sukarne ki sab se chhoti ikai (unit) hai. Sarcomere mein patle filaments Z-line se beech ki taraf barhte hain aur wahan mote filaments ke saath ek doosre par chadh jate hain (overlap). Yeh overlap A-band banata hai; A-band ke beech ek halka hissa H-band hai jahan overlap nahin hota (Fig. 12.20).

blocks.title: Khulasa
blocks.text:
Skeletal muscle ki tarteeb mukhtasar mein:
• Skeletal muscle cells ke guchhon se bana hai jinhen muscle fibres kehte hain.
• Har muscle fibre ke cytoplasm mein myofibrils ke guchhe hain.
• Har myofibril do qism ke myofilaments (myosin aur actin) se bani hai.

blocks.alt: Ek skeletal patha jo tendon se haddi se jura hai; us ke kate sire par muscle fibres ka guchha (bundle). Ek muscle fibre (ek cell) bara bana hai, myofibrils ke gird sarcolemma aur sarcoplasmic reticulum ke saath; ek chhota khaaka dikhata hai ke sarcolemma T-tubules banata hai. Pattiyon wala myofibril jis par sarcomere aur actin aur myosin myofilaments nishan zada hain; teer ek sarcomere tak jata hai jis mein H zone, I band, A band, I band, Z lines, myosin aur actin hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.20: Skeletal patthe ki ultrastructure (kitab ki Figure 12.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bare se chhote ki taraf chalein: patha, phir reshon ka guchha, phir ek resha (cell), phir myofibril, phir sarcomere, phir filaments. Sarcomere mein A band mote myosin ki lambai hai, I band sirf patle actin ka hissa, aur H zone beech ka woh hissa jahan sirf myosin hai. Do Z lines ke darmiyan ek sarcomere hai.

Muscle ke sukarne ke waqt patle filaments A-band mein mazeed andar phisal jate hain, jis se H-band aur I-band tang ho jate hain. A-bands ek doosre ke qareeb kheench liye jate hain aur muscle chhota ho jata hai. H-band ke beech ek gehri lakeer ho sakti hai jise M line kehte hain; yeh mote filaments ko apni jagah thame rakhti hai.
Myofilaments ki biochemistry

Mote myofilaments taqreeban 16 nm (nanometre) mote hote hain aur bohat se myosin proteins se bane hain. Har myosin protein do aapas mein lipti (intertwined) polypeptide chains se bana hai jo ek gol “sar” (head) par khatam hoti hain. Yeh myosin heads mote filaments se bahar nikle hote hain aur muscle ke sukarne ke waqt actin se jurte hain (Fig. 12.21).

Patle myofilaments 7-8 nm mote hote hain aur teen proteins se bane hain: (i) in ka beech ka hissa (core) actin ki do bal khayi lariyon (strands) se bana hai. (ii) Tropomyosin ki do lariyan actin ke gird lipat kar use sakht karti hain. Dheele muscle fibre mein yeh actin par myosin ke jurne ki jagahen (binding sites) dhaanp kar rakhti hain. (iii) Troponin protein patle filaments par thore thore fasle par hota hai. Yeh teen polypeptides se bana hai: ek polypeptide rokne wala (inhibitory) hai aur actin se jurta hai; doosra tropomyosin se jur kar use apni jagah thame rakhta hai; teesra calcium ions se jurta hai.

blocks.alt: Upar: myosin filament jis ke dono hisson se bohat se heads nikle hain. Teer ek myosin molecule tak jata hai: do guthi hui polypeptides jo do heads par khatam hoti hain. Neeche: actin filament jo actin ke daanon ki do bal khayi ladiyon ka hai, us ke saath lipte tropomyosin ke dhaage aur barabar faslon par troponin. Labels: Myosin filament, 2 Polypeptides, Heads, Myosin molecule, Actin, Troponin, Tropomyosin, Actin filament.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.21: Myofilaments ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 12.21 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Mota filament bohat se myosin molecules ka bana hai; har molecule ke heads hi baad mein actin ko pakar kar cross-bridges banate hain. Patle filament mein tropomyosin dheele pathe mein actin par myosin ke jurne ki jaghein dhanp deta hai, aur troponin us ko apni jagah thame rakhta hai jab tak calcium na aaye.
Muscle ke sukarne ka tareeqa: sliding filament model

Sliding filament model batata hai ke muscle kaise sukarta hai. Is model ke mutabiq muscle tab sukarta hai jab us ke patle myofilaments mote filaments ke saath saath phisal kar zyada had tak ek doosre par chadh jate hain (overlap). Yeh in qadmon mein hota hai (Fig. 12.23):

blocks.alt: Do sarcomeres. Relaxed: har sire ki Z line se actin filaments sirf kuch andar tak aate hain, aur myosin filaments ke beech chaura H-zone rehta hai; myosin ke heads cross-bridges banate hain. Contracted: actin filaments myosin par aur aage sarak gaye hain, Z lines qareeb aa gayi hain (teer) aur H-zone tang hai; myosin filaments ki lambai wahi hai. Labels: Actin filaments, H-zone, Myosin filament, Z line, Cross-bridges.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.22: Pathe ke sukarne ka sliding filament model (kitab ki Figure 12.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono halaton mein myosin aur actin ki lambai barabar hai; sirf un ka overlap barhta hai. Is liye sukarne par Z lines qareeb aati hain aur H-zone (sirf myosin wala hissa) tang ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure mein label 'Corss-bridges' chhapa hai; sahih hijje Cross-bridges hain, jo yahan likhe gaye hain.
1- Dheeli halat mein sarcomeres

Dheele muscle mein sarcomeres apni normal lambai par hote hain. Myosin heads actin se jure nahin hote, kyun ke actin par jurne ki jagahen patle filaments ke tropomyosin ne dhaanp rakhi hoti hain. Ek aur protein, troponin, tropomyosin se jura hota hai. Myosin heads pehle hi ATP ko ADP aur Pi (phosphate) mein tor (hydrolyse kar) chuke hote hain.

blocks.title: Nerve se muscle tak
blocks.text: Jab nerve impulse sarcolemma tak pohanchta hai to motor neuron synapse (nerve aur muscle ke milap ki jagah) par ek neurotransmitter, acetylcholine, chhorta hai. Yeh sarcolemma ko apne electrochemical impulses banane par uksata hai, jo muscle fibre ke andar T-tubules tak jate hain.
2- Nerve impulse ka pohanchna

Jab nerve impulse muscle fibre tak pohanchta hai to sarcolemma ke saath saath T-tubules tak aur phir sarcoplasmic reticulum (SR) tak jata hai. SR cytosol (cell ke mayah) mein calcium ions chhorta hai. Yeh calcium ions troponin se jurte hain, aur troponin tropomyosin ko actin par myosin ke jurne ki jagahon se hata deta hai.

blocks.alt: Ghari ki suiyon ki simt chaar marhale, surkh teeron se jure, har ek mein mote filament ke upar patla filament aur notes. Upar: actin par binding sites band; myosin head ke paas ADP aur P. Daen: Ca ions troponin se jurte hain, sites khul jati hain aur head jur jata hai (cross-bridge). Neeche: power stroke, head ADP aur P chhor kar actin ko beech ki taraf kheenchta hai (teer). Baen: ATP head se jurta hai aur head actin se alag ho jata hai.
blocks.caption: Fig. 12.23: Power-stroke ke marhale (cross bridge cycle) (kitab ki Figure 12.23 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar se shuru karein aur surkh teeron ke saath chalein. Calcium troponin ko hilata hai, troponin tropomyosin ko sites se hata deta hai, head jur kar jhukta hai (power stroke) aur actin ko kheenchta hai. Naya ATP head ko chhurata hai aur us ka toot kar ADP aur P banna head ko dobara tayyar kar deta hai. ATP na ho to head jura reh jata hai (rigor mortis).
3- Cross-bridges aur power stroke

Jab actin par jurne ki jagahen khul jati hain to myosin heads un se jur kar cross-bridges banate hain. Cross-bridges banne ke baad myosin heads ADP aur Pi chhor dete hain aur apni shakal badalte hain (conformational change). Yeh sarcomere ke beech ki taraf jhukte hain aur actin filaments ko apne saath kheench lete hain. Is kheenchne ko power stroke kehte hain. Is se sarcomere chhota hota hai, Z-lines qareeb aa jati hain aur H-zone khatam ho jata hai. Yeh tamam sarcomeres mein ek saath hota hai, is liye poora muscle sukar jata hai. Saath wale sarcomeres ke A-bands ek doosre ke qareeb aa jate hain magar khud chhote nahin hote.
4- Myosin heads ka actin se alag hona

Kheenchne ke baad myosin head ko ATP ka naya molecule milta hai. Is se head actin se alag ho jata hai. Phir is ATP ke ADP aur Pi mein tootne se head wapas apni pehli shakal mein aa jata hai aur cross-bridge cycle dobara shuru ho sakta hai.

blocks.title: Rigor mortis
blocks.text: Maut ke baad cells ATP nahin bana sakte, is liye cross-bridges toot nahin sakte. Isi se maut ke baad muscles akar jate hain; isay rigor mortis kehte hain. Zinda cell mein hamesha itna ATP hota hai ke myosin heads actin se alag ho sakein.
Hilne wale joron par skeletal muscles ki tarteeb

Skeletal muscles haddiyon se sakht connective tissue ke zariye jure hote hain jinhen tendons kehte hain. Aam taur par ek muscle do mukhtalif haddiyon se jura hota hai. Jo sira sukarne ke waqt na hilne wali haddi se jura ho use origin kehte hain, aur jo sira hilne wali haddi se jura ho use insertion kehte hain. Muscle ke beech ke mote hisse ko belly kehte hain (Fig. 12.24).

Jor par haddi ko do simton mein hilane ke liye muscles joron (pairs) mein kaam karte hain. Sukarne par yeh ulti (opposing) harkat karte hain. Muscles ki is tarteeb ko antagonistic arrangement kehte hain. Is mein jab ek muscle, jise flexor kehte hain, sukarta hai to jor par haddi ko mor deta hai. Jab mukhalif muscle, jise extensor kehte hain, sukarta hai to haddi ko seedha kar deta hai.
Is antagonistic amal mein jab ek muscle (maslan flexor) sukarta hai to doosra (extensor) dheela hota hai, aur is ka ulat bhi.

blocks.alt: Bazu ki haddiyan pehlu se: scapula, humerus, aur mure hue bazu ki radius aur ulna. Biceps humerus ke aage scapula par apne origins se, belly se guzar kar, tendon ke zariye radius par insertion tak jata hai; triceps humerus ke peechhe apne origins se kohni ke peechhe ulna par insertion tak. Teer flexion (upar) aur extension (neeche) dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.24: Kohni ke jor par skeletal pathon ki tarteeb (kitab ki Figure 12.24 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Bazu ki haddiyan pehlu se: scapula, humerus, aur mure hue bazu ki radius aur ulna. Biceps humerus ke aage scapula par apne origins se, belly se guzar kar, tendon ke zariye radius par insertion tak jata hai; triceps humerus ke peechhe apne origins se kohni ke peechhe ulna par insertion tak. Teer flexion (upar) aur extension (neeche) dikhate hain. Labels: Origins of biceps, Belly, Scapula, Flexion, Tendon, Origins of triceps, Extension, Humerus, Ulna, Radius, Insertion of biceps, Insertion of triceps.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Origin woh sira hai jo na hilne wali haddi (scapula) se jura hai, insertion woh jo hilne wali haddi se. Biceps sukarta hai to radius ko upar kheench kar kohni morta hai (flexion); triceps sukarta hai to ulna ko kheench kar bazu seedha karta hai (extension). Ek sukarta hai to doosra dheela parta hai: yeh antagonistic jora hai.
Ghutne ke jor par harkat (Movement at Knee Joint)

Ghutne ka jor femur (raan ki haddi) aur tibia aur fibula (nichli taang ki haddiyon) ke beech hai. Nichli taang ko morna (flexion) hamstrings karte hain. Hamstrings raan ke peechhe teen muscles ka group hai. Hamstrings ka origin pelvic girdle aur femur ke oopar ke hisse par hai, aur insertion fibula aur tibia ke oopri hisson par.

Nichli taang ko seedha karna (extension) quadriceps karte hain. Quadriceps raan ke aage chaar muscles ka group hai. Quadriceps ka origin ilium (pelvic girdle ka hissa) aur femur par hai, aur insertion patella (ghutne ki chapni) aur tibia par. Jab hamstrings sukarte hain to nichli taang mur jati hai aur quadriceps dheele hote hain. Jab quadriceps sukarte hain to nichli taang seedhi ho jati hai aur hamstrings dheele hote hain.

blocks.alt: Pehlu se do taangein. Baen: raan ke peechhe hamstrings sukarte hain aur nichli taang peechhe mur jati hai (flexed); dheele quadriceps nahin dikhaye gaye. Daen: raan ke aage quadriceps patella ke zariye kheench kar sukarte hain aur nichli taang seedhi ho jati hai (extended); dheele hamstrings nahin dikhaye gaye.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.25: Ghutne ke jor par harkat (kitab ki Figure 12.25 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har taang mein sirf sukarne wala patha dikhaya gaya hai, jaisa kitab mein hai. Hamstrings peechhe se kheench kar ghutna morte hain; quadriceps aage se patella ke zariye kheench kar ghutna seedha karte hain. Yeh bhi ek antagonistic jora hai.
Muscles ki bimariyan (Muscle Disorders)
Muscles ki kuch aam bimariyan yeh hain.
1- Muscle fatigue (muscles ki thakan)

Muscle fatigue ka matlab hai der tak ya bohat zyada jismani mehnat ke baad, ya kisi bimari ki wajah se, muscle ki karkardagi (performance) kam ho jana. Alamaat: dard, muscle ki taqat mein kami aur jaldi thak jana (endurance kam hona). Muscle fatigue ki wajahen yeh hain:

items: Warzish ke dauran muscles sukarne ke liye ATP istemal karte hain. Jab ATP khatam ho jaye to muscle sukar nahin pata.
Kaam karte hue muscles metabolic fuzla (wastes) banate hain, maslan lactate, hydrogen ions aur reactive oxygen. Yeh fuzla thakan barhata hai.
Jab muscle fibres baar baar kaam karte hain to calcium ions ko theek se sambhal nahin pate, jis se muscle ka kaam bigar jata hai.
Der tak ya bohat sakht warzish se muscle fibres ko thora nuqsan pohanchta hai, jis se sozish (inflammation) hoti hai aur muscle ka kaam kam ho jata hai.

blocks.text: Muscle fatigue aam taur par aaram karne se theek ho jati hai. Agar shadeed ho to doctor ko dikhana zaroori hai.
2- Muscle cramps (ainthan)

Muscle cramps kisi muscle ya muscles ke group ka achanak, apne aap (involuntary) aur aksar dard wala sukar jana hai. Yeh aam taur par chand seconds se kai minute tak rehte hain aur zyada tar taangon aur paon mein hote hain. Aam wajahen: jism mein pani ki kami (dehydration), namkiyat (salts) ka adam tawazun, muscle ka zyada istemal ya chot, kuch dawaen (maslan diuretics, peshab barhane wali dawaen), aur diabetes, jigar ki bimari aur nerves ke nuqsan jaisi bimariyan.
Cramp door karne ke liye mutasira muscle ko aahista se khenchein (stretch) aur malish karein. Us jagah garam ya thanda sekna aur dard ki dawa bhi madad karti hai.
3- Tetany

Tetany aisi halat hai jis mein muscles apne aap sukarte ya ainthte (spasms) hain, kyun ke muscles ka tanao (tone) barh jata hai aur nerves bohat zyada hassas (hyperexcitable) ho jati hain. Yeh sukar jism ke mukhtalif hisson mein ho sakta hai, maslan haath, paon, chehra ya larynx (aawaz ki dibbi). Tetany ki sab se aam wajah hypocalcaemia (khoon mein calcium ki kami) hai, jo vitamin D ki kami, gurdon ke fail hone (renal failure) ya thyroid ki bimariyon ki wajah se ho sakti hai. Tetany doosri namkiyat ke adam tawazun se bhi ho sakti hai, maslan khoon mein magnesium ki kami. Ilaj asal wajah par munhasir hai. Agar wajah namkiyat ka adam tawazun ho to calcium ya magnesium ki goliyan (supplements) ya drip (intravenous fluids) de kar electrolytes ka tawazun theek kiya jata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab “thyroid disorders” likhti hai. Khoon mein calcium ko control karne wala hormone (parathyroid hormone) asal mein parathyroid glands banati hain, jo thyroid ke peechhe hoti hain. Is liye hypocalcaemia ki ek aam wajah parathyroid ki kami hai, maslan thyroid ke operation mein parathyroid glands ko nuqsan pohanchna.
Tetany aur tetanus mein farq
Tetany aur tetanus alag alag bimariyan hain, lekin milte julte naam ki wajah se aksar gadmad ho jati hain:

items: Tetany mein muscles ka tanao barh jata hai aur nerves zyada active ho jati hain, jis se muscles apne aap sukarte ya ainthte hain. Tetanus ek shadeed bacterial infection hai jo Clostridium tetani bacteria se hota hai; yeh bacteria ek zeher (toxin) banata hai jo nervous system par asar karta hai aur muscles akar jate aur ainthte hain.
Tetany jism ke mukhtalif hisson (haath, paon, chehra ya larynx) ko mutasir kar sakti hai. Tetanus zyada tar jabre aur gardan ke muscles ko mutasir karta hai.
Tetany electrolytes (namkiyat) ke adam tawazun ya nerves ke masail se hoti hai. Tetanus ek khaas bacterial infection se hota hai.
Tetanus tetany ke muqable mein zyada khatarnak hai aur jaan le sakta hai.

blocks.title: Muscles kheenchte hain, dhakelte nahin
blocks.text: Muscles sirf kheench sakte hain, dhakel nahin sakte. Wajah yeh hai ke muscle fibres sirf sukar kar chhote ho sakte hain; is tarah woh tendon ko kheench kar haddi ko hilate hain. Jab muscle sukarta hai to tendon ke zariye haddi ko kheenchta hai, aur jab dheela hota hai to haddi (doosre muscle ke kheenchne se) wapas apni jagah aa jati hai. Muscle haddi se dono siron par jura hota hai: ek sira origin (na hilne wali haddi) aur doosra insertion (hilne wali haddi).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is box mein likhti hai ke “muscles aam taur par sirf ek sire par haddi se jure hote hain”. Yeh ghalat hai, aur kitab khud pehle likh chuki hai ke muscle ke do sire hain, origin aur insertion, jo do mukhtalif haddiyon se jure hote hain. Muscle is liye dhakel nahin sakta ke us ke fibres sirf sukar kar chhote ho sakte hain; use dobara lamba mukhalif (antagonistic) muscle ka kheenchna karta hai.

blocks.title: Skeleton rods aur levers ka nizam hai
blocks.text: Skeleton chharon (rods) aur levers ke nizam ki tarah kaam karta hai. Haddiyan chharen hain jo jism ko banawat aur sahara deti hain aur andar ke aza ki hifazat karti hain. Is nizam mein jor (joints) levers ke liye fulcrum (ghoomne ka nuqta) hain, jin ki wajah se harkat hoti hai. Muscles effort (zor) lagate hain, aur jo wazan ya rukawat hilai ja rahi ho woh load hai. Maslan wazan uthate waqt bazu ke neeche wale hisse (forearm) ki haddiyan lever hain, kohni ka jor fulcrum hai, biceps effort lagata hai aur wazan load hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke wazan uthate waqt “bazu ka biceps muscle lever ka kaam karta hai”. Yeh theek nahin: biceps effort (zor) deta hai, jaisa kitab agle jumle mein khud kehti hai. Lever forearm ki haddiyan (radius aur ulna) hain, aur kohni ka jor fulcrum.

blocks.caption: Tetany aur tetanus
rows: Barha hua pathon ka tanao aur zyada faal asaab jo ghair-ikhtiyari sukar ya ainthan karte hain

Zyada sangeen aur mumkina taur par jan-lewa

blocks.prompt: Ek daurne wale ki pindli ke pathe daur ke aakhir mein jawab de dete hain, aur kam khoon ke calcium wale mareez ko haathon ki ainthan hoti hai. Har ek ko cross-bridge cycle mein ATP aur calcium ke kirdar se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Daurne wale ka patha thaka hua hai: us ka ATP khatm ho gaya hai, lactate jaise metabolic fuzle jama ho gaye hain aur reshe calcium ko kam achhi tarah sambhalte hain, to myosin ke sar cycle jari nahin rakh sakte aur patha zor se sukar nahin sakta; aaram use bahal karta hai. Mareez mein kam calcium asaab ko hyperexcitable banata aur pathon ka tanao barhata hai, to reshe tetany mein ghair-ikhtiyari taur par sukarte hain; calcium ke supplements ya intravenous mayah tawazun bahal karte hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Teen muscle tissues: skeletal (dhaari dar, bohat se nuclei, ikhtiyari, skeleton hilata hai), smooth (takla numa, ek nucleus, bina dhaari, ghair-ikhtiyari, khokhle aza), cardiac (shakhdar, dhaari dar, ek nucleus, ghair-ikhtiyari, dil).

Muscle fibre: sarcolemma (T-tubules banati hai), sarcoplasm, sarcoplasmic reticulum, 4-20 myofibrils. Myofibril mein mote myosin aur patle actin filaments; Z-line se Z-line tak sarcomere; A-band, I-band, H-band, M line.
Mota filament: myosin (do polypeptide chains, gol head). Patla filament: actin, tropomyosin, troponin (teen polypeptides; ek calcium se jurta hai).

Sliding filament model: nerve impulse → SR se calcium → troponin tropomyosin ko hatata hai → myosin heads cross-bridges banate hain → power stroke actin ko beech ki taraf kheenchta hai → naya ATP head ko alag karta hai. ATP na ho to rigor mortis.
Muscles sirf kheenchte hain; antagonistic jore: kohni par biceps (flexor) aur triceps (extensor), ghutne par hamstrings (morna) aur quadriceps (seedha karna).
Bimariyan: muscle fatigue (ATP khatam, fuzla, calcium), cramps (pani aur namak ki kami, zyada istemal), tetany (calcium ya magnesium ki kami). Tetanus Clostridium tetani ka infection hai.
